learnings.title: Shopify developer changelog feed: currententrychange now returns the previous page in event.from for customer account full-page extensions
learnings.claim: Shopify developer changelog feed fetched 2026-11-04 lists as newest item: "currententrychange now returns the previous page in event.from for customer account full-page extensions" (Sat, 31 Oct 2026 16:00:00 +0000). Not independently verified.
learnings.decision: REVIEW_ONLY: The 'video_shopify' plan should review customer account full-page extension navigation logic to evaluate how 'event.from' in 'currententrychange' events affects user behavior tracking or video playback states, taking no immediate action.
learnings.next_measurement: Reviewer opens the item link and confirms relevance before promotion.
